control_per_guest_tool.what: authorize (tool.call read to tool.grant sent) plus ack (tool.done read to tool.recorded sent), at the controller's side of the channel

control_per_guest_tool.note: The capability is new: trunk has no guest tool, so no ratio is reported. Numbers are on PGlite in memory; a production database adds one network round trip per query, and a remote guest adds two channel round trips per tool. Both are inferences, not measurements.
